subject: SIG intake: section segmentation & owner nominations
messages:
From: Riverton Security Team <security@rivertonbank.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG request for vendor intake - Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / Priyom,

Thanks for agreeing to support Riverton Bank's vendor SIG. Attached is our SIG spreadsheet (we use the standard SIG v1 layout) and an initial evidence index template. Our procurement window is tight: we need a completed SIG and supporting evidence within three weeks to hit our Q2 security review.

Two asks to start:
- Can you confirm who on your side will own which top-level sections (Infrastructure, Identity & Access, Data Protection, Incident Mgmt, Vendor Management)?
- Can you confirm expected timelines for document pulls and evidence collection?

I've attached the SIG file and the evidence_index_template.csv for your intake. If helpful, Lila Graham (cc'd) will act as our security ops point of contact for clarifying questions.

Thanks,
Riverton Security Team
security@rivertonbank.com

Attachments: SIG_Riverton_2027_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet), evidence_index_template.csv (csv)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Riverton Security Team <security@rivertonbank.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request for vendor intake - Redwood Inference

Hi Lila / Riverton team — thanks for the packet and the timeline.

We're pulling a quick intake and assigning owners today so we can give you a clear target. Proposal below (feel free to object):

- Infrastructure / Network diagrams + Config: Vivek Kulkarni
- Identity & Access Controls (IAM, SSO, role mapping): Priyom Das
- Data Protection (encryption, key mgmt, DLP): Neha Kapoor
- Incident Response / Logging / Retention: Tessa Morgan
- Vendor & Third-party mgmt / Subprocessors list: Marissa Cole (me)

Planned cadence: owner kickoff today, evidence pull over next 7 business days, internal review week of 2027-05-31, hand back to Riverton by 2027-06-07. If you need anything earlier, let us know which sections are highest priority.

I'll start a shared drive folder and populate the evidence_index.csv template. Priyom — can you confirm the IAM artefacts you need access to and whether a sanitized export will suffice?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales & Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (referenced) evidence_index_template.csv

Date: 2027-05-22T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake - section owners

All good on my side — I'll take Incident Response and Logging. Quick notes:
- I have the current runbook and the post-incident blameless review template; those will address the majority of the IR questions.
- For logging retention windows, we have a couple of different retention policies by product; I'll flag any gaps vs. the SIG expected answers.
- ETA: draft evidence uploaded 2027-05-26, final pass 2027-05-31.

Marissa — added a short checklist in the shared folder for evidence format (PDF vs. screenshots vs. combined export).

Tessa
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake - evidence windows and notes

Couple of follow-ups from my end after a quick scan of the SIG workbook: 
- For Data Protection section, I'll need confirmation on KMS provider and whether Riverton requires key provenance screenshots or a signed statement from our KMS partner.
- I'll prepare a redaction guidance note (sensitive metadata) and upload a sample encrypted-at-rest policy.
- ETA: initial artefacts 2027-05-27; ask: can Riverton accept redacted config screenshots for the first pass?

Lila (Riverton) — is redacted material acceptable for initial intake? If not, we can prioritize sanitized exports but need an extra day.

Neha Kapoor
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — quick confirmation from my side:
- IAM owner nominated (I'll gather SSO metadata, SCIM mappings, role lists). Expect a sanitized export by 2027-05-25.
- Vivek / Neha — please flag any infra or data-protection dependencies you need from platform/ops early.

Shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/SIG/Riverton-2027 (I've created the folders and the evidence_index.csv is pre-populated).

Riverton / Lila — redacted screenshots are fine for initial review; if you require signed attestations for keys we can coordinate next week.

If there are any priority sections you'd like expedited, call them out and we'll bump the owner to rush lane.

Best,
